landing.title: Aapki problem aur solution ke beech ek setu
landing.subtitle: Setu aapke aas-paas ki roz ki problems ko un universities aur experts se jodta hai jo unhe solve kar sakte hain — report se resolution tak, poori tarah transparent.
landing.step1_body: Problem batayein, photo add karein, location mark karein.
landing.step2_body: Setu report ko padhkar sahi university department tak bhejta hai.
landing.step3_body: Faculty aur students team banakar solution pe kaam karte hain.
landing.step4_body: Kabhi bhi status track karein — submit se resolve tak.

auth.error_generic: Kuch galat ho gaya. Details check karke phir try karein.

track.title: Meri reports
